Splitify for Android (Android 8.0 / API 26 or later). Installs as an update over any earlier version; your data stays in your Google account.

## What's new

**Individual Expenses**
- Each item now shows **Paid** (amount paid) and **Share** (that person's share) in neutral white, in both the Names and Items views. Net has been removed.
- Payments recorded with **Paid** in Settlements appear here: money sent shows under Paid, money received shows as Received.

**Adding expenses**
- Name suggestions: earlier expense names (this event and your recent ones) appear as chips while you type. Tapping one fills the name and its last amount.
- The Add Expense window now scrolls on its own and stays above the keyboard, and the page behind it no longer scrolls (fixes iPhone Safari).

**Android notifications**
- New in-app notifications also appear in the phone's notification tray while the app is open or running in the background. Tap one to open its event. Android 13+ asks for permission the first time.

## Install
Download **Splitify-v1.5.0.apk** below and open it on your Android device.
